title: Carnot limit
references: Carnot, S., Reflexions sur la puissance motrice du feu, Bachelier, Paris (1824)
Callen, H. B., Thermodynamics and an Introduction to Thermostatistics, 2nd ed., Wiley (1985)
validity_domain: Heat engine cycle exchanging heat with two reservoirs at constant absolute temperatures Th > Tc > 0.
limitations: Applies to an engine exchanging heat with two reservoirs only
Reached only by a reversible cycle, so a theoretical bound that real engines do not reach

variables.Th: Absolute temperature of the hot reservoir
variables.Tc: Absolute temperature of the cold reservoir
